CustomField.formula:
IF( DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > DATE(2026, 01, 19),
Total_Vehicle_RollUp__c - (State_Govt_Subsidy__c + Subsidy_Amount__c + Discount_on_Ex_Showroom_Price__c + Offers_Amount__c) + RTO_Charges__c + Insurance_Amount__c + Handling_Charges__c + Transportation_Charges__c + Total_Accessories_RollUp__c + Total_Merchandise_RollUp__c,
Total_Vehicle_RollUp__c - ( Offers_Amount__c + State_Govt_Subsidy__c + Discount_on_Ex_Showroom_Price__c + Subsidy_Amount__c ) + RTO_Charges__c + Insurance_Amount__c + Handling_Charges__c + Transportation_Charges__c + (Total_Accessories_RollUp__c - Accessories_Discount_Amount__c) + ( Total_Merchandise_RollUp__c - Merchandise_Additional_Discount__c ) )
CustomField.label: Grand Total
